title: Shannon observables: A scalable approach to information decomposition
abstract: arXiv:2504.15779v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Distributed systems, such as biological and artificial neural networks, process information via complex interactions engaging multiple subsystems, resulting in high-order structure of the information within the system with distinct properties across scales. Investigating how these systems process information remains challenging due to difficulties in defining appropriate multivariate metrics and ensuring their scalability to large systems. To address these challenges, we introduce a novel framework based on what we call "Shannon observables": quantities that capture essential properties of high-order information processing, yet can be computed directly from Shannon entropies and scale efficiently to large systems. Our theoretical results demonstrate how Shannon observables can be used to resolve long-standing ambiguities regarding the interpretation of widely used multivariate information-theoretic measures. tldr: 该论文提出了“香农观测量”这一新框架，它能直接从香农熵计算得出并可高效扩展到大型系统，从而捕捉高阶信息处理的本质特性，并解决了多变量信息论测度解释中长期存在的模糊性问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "Shannon observables," a novel framework that captures essential properties of high-order information processing, can be computed directly from Shannon entropies, scales efficiently to large systems, and resolves long-standing ambiguities in interpreting multivariate information-theoretic measures.
